messages:
sam (on-call): alert - Dedicated pool eu-prod-pool crossing CPU and queue thresholds, sustained 4xx/5xx, paging.

dev-bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-0621 severity=P1. Notifying on-call.

jess (sre): saw it. can you paste p95/p99 and error types?

sam (on-call): p95 2.2s, p99 5.1s. Errors primarily 503 gateway, a handful of rate-limit 429 from internal proxy. Queues rising to 6000.

anya (infra): autoscaler logs show backoff: pool hit soft limit max_instances=100 and burst disabled. Current instances 99. Policy has no burst allowed because pool labeled 'no-burst' for compliance.

acct-eng: customer 'FinFlow' spiking (webhook batch retry loop). They're enterprise but on dedicated shared pool. we need to avoid throttling enterprise.

jess (sre): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily enable burst on eu-prod-pool for 15m 2) bump pool max to 180 3) apply selective rate-shaping for non-enterprise tenants and background jobs 4) disable heavy eval endpoint /eval-v2 on this pool.

anya (infra): I can flip burst. running: `infra-cli pool set eu-prod-pool --burst true --max 180` now.

dev-bot: Command executed by anya at 2026-03-15T16:05:12Z. Autoscaler policy re-evaluated.

sam (on-call): applying traffic shaping: `trafficctl shape --pool eu-prod-pool --match "tenant!=FinFlow && job!=system-batch" --rate 50rps --duration 20m`

traffic-bot: Traffic rule applied. ~95k keys affected. Non-enterprise traffic shaped to 50rps on this pool.

jess (sre): disabling /eval-v2 on pool: `featurectl toggle eval-v2 --pool eu-prod-pool --off`. pushing a lightweight fallback for customers.

acct-eng: confirmed FinFlow unaffected. I'll message CS to inform other impacted accounts of temporary throttling and feature pause.

sam (on-call): monitoring... p95 now 650ms, p99 1.8s, queue down to ~900. 503s reduced by ~78%.

anya (infra): autoscaler added 60 burst nodes, pool at 159. keeping burst for 20m. note: enabling burst required a temporary waiver recorded in compliance-tracker.

jess (sre): good. create incident ticket with timeline and actions. include decision to exclude enterprise tenants from shaping.

sam (on-call): filed INC-2026-0621-POSTMORTEM draft and added temporary mitigation steps. scheduling handoff to julia in 30m.

dev-bot: Reminder: on-call rotation handoff in 30 minutes. Next on-call: julia.

sam (on-call): thanks team. leaving notes for handoff: burst enabled, pool max bumped to 180, non-enterprise shape 50rps, /eval-v2 off, monitor metrics and prepare to revert when stable.
